# `aitbc blockchain remove`

Remove a chain from a specific node, optionally migrating first.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain remove [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--node-id` | text | — | yes | The Node id. |
| `--migrate` | flag | `false` | no | Migrate to another node before removal |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain remove --chain-id <chain_id> --node-id <node_id>
```
